events.verdict: Ball (LAL) firms up to his legal spot and makes marginal contact with Westbrook (OKC) during his driving shot attempt.
Zubac (LAL) makes some contact with Adams (OKC) during the rebound, but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Hart (LAL) makes contact to the head of Westbrook (OKC) on the play at the basket.
Ball (LAL) makes slight contact with Westbrook (OKC) without fully extending his off-arm during his drive.
Kuzma (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of George (OKC) and absorbs contact during the screen.
Adams (OKC) maintains an established screening position as he firms up and absorbs the contact to Zubac (LAL).
Ball (LAL) makes contact to the body of Westbrook (OKC) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Ball (LAL) firms up on Grant's (OKC) shoulder during the screen, but he is able to move through contact.
Adams (OKC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Ball (LAL) and does not deliver contact.
Hart (LAL) makes contact to the body of Westbrook (OKC) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Grant (OKC) makes incidental contact to the arm of Ball (LAL) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Adams (OKC) makes contact with Hart's (LAL) arm and body, causing him to lose control of the ball.
Adams (OKC) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Hart (LAL) and does not deliver contact.
Zubac (LAL) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Westbrook (OKC) that affects his driving shot attempt.
LLB shows Adams (OKC) makes contact to Ingram's (LAL) head that affects his ability to retrieve the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Frame by frame shows that Kuzma does not have his foot down in the front court as the 24 second clock reaches 15.
Adams (OKC) makes marginal contact with Kuzma (LAL) at the start of his drive, but he is able to move through the contact without it affecting his SQBR.
Grant (OKC) cleanly blocks Kuzma's (LAL) driving shot attempt.
A 24 second violation is called upon the Lakers.
Ball (LAL) makes contact to the arm of Westbrook (OKC) prior to him gathering the ball and starting his upward shooting motion.
Kuzma (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of George (OKC) and makes marginal contact with George's (OKC) arm during the screen.
George (OKC) maintains verticality on Kuzma's (LAL) jump shot.
